items.q: But I told Lennie that I had to leave the group because I didn't think I was doing my job, see.

ctx.x: But I told Lennie that I had to leave the group because I didn't think I was doing my job, see. And Lennie said, 'What's wrong with you? You've learned the numbers faster than any of the best readers we have. And you're playing the numbers fine. This was in Los Angeles, at the Cocoanut Grove, there. That's where I left them.'
So it affected you that much, that you --
